'''Ray Liu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 San Jose tournament (11 November)]] on 11 November 2000 with Fondor-Combat Response start, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1450">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-san-jose-ca-11-11-00d1450/ san-jose-ca-11-11-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 12 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-san-jose-ca-11-11-00d1450/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
